SELECT T1.driver_id ,  T2.nationality FROM drivers AS T1 JOIN laptimes AS T2 ON T1.driver_id = T2.driver_id WHERE T2.milliseconds > 100000
SELECT T1.part_name ,  COUNT(*) FROM Parts AS T1 JOIN Assets AS T2 ON T1.part_id  =  T2.part_id GROUP BY T1.part_id
SELECT T1.name FROM film_studio AS T1 JOIN films AS T2 ON T1.studio_id  =  T2.studio_id GROUP BY T1.studio_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT college) FROM players WHERE team  =  'Columbus Crew'
SELECT T1.mountain_id ,  T1.name FROM Mountains AS T1 JOIN Mountain_Photos AS T2 ON T1.mountain_id  =  T2.mountain_id GROUP BY T1.mountain_id HAVING COUNT(*)  >=  2
SELECT count(*) FROM Students WHERE allergy  =  'cat'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE language != 'English'
SELECT air_date FROM episodes WHERE title = "A Love of a Lifetime"
SELECT Allergy_Type ,  COUNT(*) FROM Student_Allergies GROUP BY Allergy_Type
